These frames are a heavy remix of the frames from FMDA - huge thanks to their work and inspiration on many of my projects. They have been stylized based on the grip profile of the CZ P-07/P-09 and I've added both compact and full size versions. Also, a nice stipple. 
They are designed to use parts kits from the EAA Witness P, which is the polymer SMALL FRAME of the witness in 9mm or 40 S&W.
Additionally, MPRTECH has modified the witness frames to be compatible with the SAR Arms B6 frames which have 
a slightly different rear housing. When searching for parts kits, please be aware that these kits have integrated rails both front and rear. If you don't see the rail inserts, you're not looking at the right kits. 

The small frame witness uses a smaller grip and magazine and was discountinued in the early 2000's. This will not work with witness steel frame kits because they lack the rails, or the newer witness frame kits designed for LARGE FRAMES. If you have a question on compatibility, feel free to reach out to me on twitter @ArthurClaudeen. This is designed for SMALL FRAME FULL SIZE magazines. They hold 17 rounds.
